items.question: Trong câu "BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is the international standard for modeling business processes, maintained by the OMG.", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is the international standard for modeling business processes, maintained by the OMG.", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /noʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): hệ ký hiệu. "Notation" là bộ ký hiệu quy ước (ví dụ ký hiệu BPMN, Big-O notation).
items.explanationEn: notation /noʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a system of symbols. Notation is an agreed set of symbols, as in BPMN notation or Big-O notation.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is the international standard for modeling business processes, maintained by the OMG.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is the international standard for modeling business processes, maintained by the OMG.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì. Tiêu chuẩn được một tổ chức "maintain" = cập nhật và quản lý; danh từ: maintenance (bảo trì).
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep up to date. A standard maintained by a body is kept up to date by it; noun: maintenance.

items.question: Trong câu "The problem it solves: flowcharts are easy to read but lack notation for things that matter in real business — time events, messages between parties, subprocesses, error handling, parallel paths.", từ "lack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The problem it solves: flowcharts are easy to read but lack notation for things that matter in real business — time events, messages between parties, subprocesses, error handling, parallel paths.", what does "lack" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lack /læk/ (động từ): thiếu. Cấu trúc: lack something (không có giới từ); danh từ: a lack of.
items.explanationEn: lack /læk/ (verb): to be without. Pattern: lack something (no preposition); noun: a lack of.

items.question: Trong câu "The problem it solves: flowcharts are easy to read but lack notation for things that matter in real business — time events, messages between parties, subprocesses, error handling, parallel paths.", từ "parallel" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The problem it solves: flowcharts are easy to read but lack notation for things that matter in real business — time events, messages between parties, subprocesses, error handling, parallel paths.", what does "parallel" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: parallel /ˈper.ə.lel/ (tính từ): song song. "Parallel paths" = các nhánh chạy đồng thời; trái nghĩa: sequential.
items.explanationEn: parallel /ˈper.ə.lel/ (adjective): simultaneous. "Parallel paths" run at the same time; opposite: sequential.

items.question: Trong câu "Complex, multi-party processes needing precision", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complex, multi-party processes needing precision", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. Tính từ: precise; "with precision" = một cách chính xác.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness. Adjective: precise; "with precision" means exactly.

items.question: Trong câu "Simple processes, quick sketches", từ "sketch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Simple processes, quick sketches", what does "sketch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sketch /sketʃ/ (danh từ): bản phác thảo. "Quick sketch" = bản vẽ nhanh, sơ bộ; nghĩa khác: sketch trên sân khấu là tiểu phẩm.
items.explanationEn: sketch /sketʃ/ (noun): a rough drawing. A "quick sketch" is a rough drawing; on stage a sketch is a short comic scene.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose by your audience, not by how impressive the notation looks.", từ "audience" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose by your audience, not by how impressive the notation looks.", what does "audience" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: audience /ˈɑː.di.əns/ (danh từ): người đọc. "Know your audience" = hiểu người nghe/đọc của mình; rất hay dùng trong giao tiếp công việc.
items.explanationEn: audience /ˈɑː.di.əns/ (noun): the intended readers. "Know your audience" means understanding who reads or listens; common workplace advice.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose by your audience, not by how impressive the notation looks.", từ "impressive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose by your audience, not by how impressive the notation looks.", what does "impressive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: impressive /ɪmˈpres.ɪv/ (tính từ): ấn tượng. Động từ: impress; danh từ: impression (ấn tượng).
items.explanationEn: impressive /ɪmˈpres.ɪv/ (adjective): striking. Verb: impress; noun: impression.

items.question: Trong câu "If you draw BPMN for a group that has never seen it, prepare a notation key and walk through an example first.", từ "walk through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you draw BPMN for a group that has never seen it, prepare a notation key and walk through an example first.", what does "walk through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: walk through /wɑːk θruː/ (cụm từ): hướng dẫn qua. Danh từ: walkthrough (buổi trình bày từng bước); "walk someone through something" = hướng dẫn ai đó.
items.explanationEn: walk through /wɑːk θruː/ (phrase): to guide through. Noun: walkthrough; "walk someone through something" means guiding them step by step.

items.question: Trong câu "If you draw BPMN for a group that has never seen it, prepare a notation key and walk through an example first.", từ "key" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you draw BPMN for a group that has never seen it, prepare a notation key and walk through an example first.", what does "key" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: key /kiː/ (danh từ): bảng chú giải. "Notation key" = bảng giải thích ký hiệu; đồng nghĩa: legend.
items.explanationEn: key /kiː/ (noun): a symbol legend. A "notation key" explains the symbols; synonym: legend.

items.question: Trong câu "Something happens: a start, an end, or something in between", từ "in between" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Something happens: a start, an end, or something in between", what does "in between" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in between /ɪn bɪˈtwiːn/ (cụm từ): ở giữa. Event trung gian nằm "in between" điểm bắt đầu và kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: in between /ɪn bɪˈtwiːn/ (phrase): in the middle. Intermediate events sit in between the start and the end.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequence flow (solid arrow) — order of execution within one pool.", từ "solid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequence flow (solid arrow) — order of execution within one pool.", what does "solid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: solid /ˈsɑː.lɪd/ (tính từ): liền nét. "Solid line" = nét liền, đối lập "dashed line" (nét đứt); "a solid plan" = kế hoạch vững chắc.
items.explanationEn: solid /ˈsɑː.lɪd/ (adjective): unbroken. A "solid line" is unbroken, unlike a dashed line; "a solid plan" is a reliable one.

items.question: Trong câu "Sequence flow (solid arrow) — order of execution within one pool.", từ "execution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sequence flow (solid arrow) — order of execution within one pool.", what does "execution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: execution /ˌek.səˈkjuː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thực thi. Động từ: execute (thực thi); "order of execution" = thứ tự thực hiện.
items.explanationEn: execution /ˌek.səˈkjuː.ʃən/ (noun): carrying out. Verb: execute; "order of execution" is the order in which steps run.

items.question: Trong câu "Message flow (dashed arrow) — a message exchanged between two different pools.", từ "dashed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Message flow (dashed arrow) — a message exchanged between two different pools.", what does "dashed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dashed /dæʃt/ (tính từ): nét đứt. "Dashed line" = nét đứt; "dotted line" = nét chấm. Nghĩa khác: "dashed hopes" = hy vọng tan vỡ.
items.explanationEn: dashed /dæʃt/ (adjective): broken into strokes. A "dashed line" uses short strokes; "dotted line" uses dots. "Dashed hopes" are crushed hopes.

items.question: Trong câu "Association (dotted line) — links an annotation or document to an element.", từ "annotation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Association (dotted line) — links an annotation or document to an element.", what does "annotation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: annotation /ˌæn.əˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): lời chú thích. Động từ: annotate (chú thích); dùng nhiều trong sơ đồ và tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: annotation /ˌæn.əˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): an explanatory note. Verb: annotate; used a lot in diagrams and documents.

items.question: Trong câu "Pool — an independent participant: your company, the customer, a bank, a supplier.", từ "independent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pool — an independent participant: your company, the customer, a bank, a supplier.", what does "independent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (tính từ): độc lập. Trái nghĩa: dependent; "independent of" = không phụ thuộc vào.
items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (adjective): self-governing. Opposite: dependent; "independent of" means not relying on.

items.question: Trong câu "Pool — an independent participant: your company, the customer, a bank, a supplier.", từ "supplier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pool — an independent participant: your company, the customer, a bank, a supplier.", what does "supplier" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: supplier /səˈplaɪ.ɚ/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. Động từ: supply (cung cấp); đồng nghĩa: vendor.
items.explanationEn: supplier /səˈplaɪ.ɚ/ (noun): a provider of goods. Verb: supply; synonym: vendor.

items.question: Trong câu "Data object — a document or data created or consumed.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data object — a document or data created or consumed.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (động từ): sử dụng. Trong hệ thống, "consume data / an API" = dùng dữ liệu / gọi API; danh từ: consumer.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (verb): to use as input. In systems, "consume data or an API" means use it as input; noun: consumer.

items.question: Trong câu "Annotation — an explanatory note.", từ "explanatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Annotation — an explanatory note.", what does "explanatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explanatory /ɪkˈsplæn.ə.tɔːr.i/ (tính từ): để giải thích. Động từ: explain; "explanatory note" = ghi chú giải thích.
items.explanationEn: explanatory /ɪkˈsplæn.ə.tɔːr.i/ (adjective): serving to explain. Verb: explain; "explanatory note".

items.question: Trong câu "Events are where BPMN goes far beyond flowcharts.", từ "go beyond" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Events are where BPMN goes far beyond flowcharts.", what does "go beyond" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go beyond /ɡoʊ biˈjɑːnd/ (cụm từ): vượt xa. "Go beyond expectations" = vượt kỳ vọng.
items.explanationEn: go beyond /ɡoʊ biˈjɑːnd/ (phrase): to exceed. "Go beyond expectations" means exceeding them.

items.question: Trong câu "Intermediate event (double border) — occurs midway.", từ "intermediate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Intermediate event (double border) — occurs midway.", what does "intermediate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intermediate /ˌɪn.t̬ɚˈmiː.di.ət/ (tính từ): trung gian. Còn nghĩa "trình độ trung cấp" (intermediate level).
items.explanationEn: intermediate /ˌɪn.t̬ɚˈmiː.di.ət/ (adjective): in the middle. Also means mid-level, as in "intermediate level".

items.question: Trong câu "Intermediate event (double border) — occurs midway.", từ "midway" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Intermediate event (double border) — occurs midway.", what does "midway" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: midway /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (trạng từ): giữa chừng. Đồng nghĩa: halfway; "midway through the process" = giữa quy trình.
items.explanationEn: midway /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (adverb): halfway through. Synonym: halfway; "midway through the process".

items.question: Trong câu "Intermediate event (double border) — occurs midway.", từ "border" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Intermediate event (double border) — occurs midway.", what does "border" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: border /ˈbɔːr.dɚ/ (danh từ): đường viền. "Double border" = viền đôi; nghĩa khác: border giữa hai quốc gia.
items.explanationEn: border /ˈbɔːr.dɚ/ (noun): an outline edge. "Double border" is a two-line outline; border also means a national frontier.

items.question: Trong câu "Processing failed, switch to a recovery path", từ "recovery" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Processing failed, switch to a recovery path", what does "recovery" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: recovery /rɪˈkʌv.ɚ.i/ (danh từ): sự khôi phục. "Disaster recovery" = khôi phục sau sự cố; động từ: recover.
items.explanationEn: recovery /rɪˈkʌv.ɚ.i/ (noun): restoration. "Disaster recovery"; verb: recover.

items.question: Trong câu "When stock falls below a threshold", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When stock falls below a threshold", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃ.hoʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng. "Above / below a threshold" = trên / dưới ngưỡng; nghĩa gốc là bậc cửa.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃ.hoʊld/ (noun): a limit level. "Above or below a threshold"; the literal sense is the sill of a door.

items.question: Trong câu "and if you do not draw it, it will not be implemented.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "and if you do not draw it, it will not be implemented.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plə.ment/ (động từ): triển khai. Danh từ: implementation; danh từ implement (/ˈɪm.plə.mənt/) còn là dụng cụ.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plə.ment/ (verb): to put into effect. Noun: implementation; the noun implement also means a tool.

items.question: Trong câu "Boundary events attach to the edge of an activity, showing what happens if something occurs while the activity is running.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Boundary events attach to the edge of an activity, showing what happens if something occurs while the activity is running.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dɚ.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Set boundaries" = đặt giới hạn; "boundary event" = sự kiện gắn trên viền hoạt động.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dɚ.i/ (noun): a dividing line. "Set boundaries" means setting limits; a boundary event sits on an activity's edge.

items.question: Trong câu "Boundary events attach to the edge of an activity, showing what happens if something occurs while the activity is running.", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Boundary events attach to the edge of an activity, showing what happens if something occurs while the activity is running.", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): gắn vào. Danh từ: attachment (tệp đính kèm); trái nghĩa: detach.
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to fix onto. Noun: attachment; opposite: detach.

items.question: Trong câu "Boundary events attach to the edge of an activity, showing what happens if something occurs while the activity is running.", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Boundary events attach to the edge of an activity, showing what happens if something occurs while the activity is running.", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): cạnh, viền. "Competitive edge" = lợi thế cạnh tranh; "edge case" = trường hợp biên.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): an outer border. "Competitive edge" is an advantage; "edge case" is an unusual boundary case.

items.question: Trong câu "This is how BPMN expresses a timeout — something flowcharts struggle to convey.", từ "struggle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is how BPMN expresses a timeout — something flowcharts struggle to convey.", what does "struggle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: struggle /ˈstrʌɡ.əl/ (động từ): chật vật. "Struggle to do something" = gặp khó khăn khi làm gì.
items.explanationEn: struggle /ˈstrʌɡ.əl/ (verb): to find it hard. "Struggle to do something" means find it hard.

items.question: Trong câu "This is how BPMN expresses a timeout — something flowcharts struggle to convey.", từ "convey" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is how BPMN expresses a timeout — something flowcharts struggle to convey.", what does "convey" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (động từ): truyền đạt. "Convey a message / meaning" = truyền đạt thông điệp / ý nghĩa; nghĩa khác: vận chuyển (conveyor belt).
items.explanationEn: convey /kənˈveɪ/ (verb): to communicate. "Convey a message"; also means to transport, as in conveyor belt.

items.question: Trong câu "This is how BPMN expresses a timeout — something flowcharts struggle to convey.", từ "express" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is how BPMN expresses a timeout — something flowcharts struggle to convey.", what does "express" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: express /ɪkˈspres/ (động từ): diễn đạt. Danh từ: expression; tính từ express còn nghĩa là nhanh (express delivery).
items.explanationEn: express /ɪkˈspres/ (verb): to represent. Noun: expression; as an adjective express means fast, as in express delivery.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where beginners go wrong most often.", từ "go wrong" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where beginners go wrong most often.", what does "go wrong" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go wrong /ɡoʊ rɑːŋ/ (cụm từ): mắc lỗi. "Where did it go wrong?" = sai ở đâu? Có thể chỉ người mắc lỗi hoặc việc hỏng.
items.explanationEn: go wrong /ɡoʊ rɑːŋ/ (phrase): to make mistakes. "Where did it go wrong?"; used for people making mistakes or things failing.

items.question: Trong câu "The conditions must be mutually exclusive.", từ "mutually exclusive" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The conditions must be mutually exclusive.", what does "mutually exclusive" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mutually exclusive /ˈmjuː.tʃu.ə.li ɪkˈskluː.sɪv/ (cụm từ): loại trừ lẫn nhau. Các điều kiện của cổng XOR không được cùng đúng; ngược lại là "overlapping".
items.explanationEn: mutually exclusive /ˈmjuː.tʃu.ə.li ɪkˈskluː.sɪv/ (phrase): unable to be true together. XOR conditions cannot be true at the same time; the opposite is overlapping.

items.question: Trong câu "One or more branches run, depending on which conditions are true.", từ "depending on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One or more branches run, depending on which conditions are true.", what does "depending on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depending on /dɪˈpen.dɪŋ ɑːn/ (cụm từ): tùy vào. "Depending on + danh từ / mệnh đề wh-" = tùy theo.
items.explanationEn: depending on /dɪˈpen.dɪŋ ɑːn/ (phrase): according to. "Depending on + noun or wh-clause" means according to.

items.question: Trong câu "Using XOR when the branches can actually co-occur.", từ "co-occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Using XOR when the branches can actually co-occur.", what does "co-occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: co-occur /ˌkoʊ.əˈkɝː/ (động từ): cùng xảy ra. Tiền tố co- = cùng: co-occur, co-author, co-worker.
items.explanationEn: co-occur /ˌkoʊ.əˈkɝː/ (verb): to coincide. Prefix co- means together: co-occur, co-author, co-worker.

items.question: Trong câu "The result: the system skips a necessary handling.", từ "necessary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result: the system skips a necessary handling.", what does "necessary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: necessary /ˈnes.ə.ser.i/ (tính từ): cần thiết. Trái nghĩa: unnecessary; danh từ: necessity.
items.explanationEn: necessary /ˈnes.ə.ser.i/ (adjective): needed. Opposite: unnecessary; noun: necessity.

items.question: Trong câu "Every XOR must have a branch for every possible outcome, including the case where no condition matches.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every XOR must have a branch for every possible outcome, including the case where no condition matches.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. "Possible outcome" = kết quả có thể xảy ra; đồng nghĩa: result.
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): a result. "Possible outcome"; synonym: result.

items.question: Trong câu "If you split with AND, you must merge with AND, or the process continues before all branches finish.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you split with AND, you must merge with AND, or the process continues before all branches finish.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): tách nhánh. Trái nghĩa trong sơ đồ: merge (gộp); "split the bill" = chia tiền.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into branches. In diagrams the opposite is merge; "split the bill" means share the cost.

items.question: Trong câu "A pool represents an independent participant — an organization whose internal process you do not control.", từ "represent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pool represents an independent participant — an organization whose internal process you do not control.", what does "represent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (động từ): biểu thị. Danh từ: representation, representative (người đại diện).
items.explanationEn: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (verb): to stand for. Nouns: representation, representative.

items.question: Trong câu "A pool represents an independent participant — an organization whose internal process you do not control.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pool represents an independent participant — an organization whose internal process you do not control.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɝː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. Trái nghĩa: external; "internal process" = quy trình nội bộ.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɝː.nəl/ (adjective): inside. Opposite: external; "internal process".

items.question: Trong câu "A black box pool (empty, nothing drawn inside) — when you only care about the messages exchanged, not what they do internally.", từ "black box" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A black box pool (empty, nothing drawn inside) — when you only care about the messages exchanged, not what they do internally.", what does "black box" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: black box /ˌblæk ˈbɑːks/ (cụm từ): hộp đen khép kín. "Black box" = chỉ quan tâm đầu vào/ra, không xem bên trong; nghĩa khác: hộp đen máy bay.
items.explanationEn: black box /ˌblæk ˈbɑːks/ (phrase): an opaque unit. A black box shows only inputs and outputs; it also means an aircraft flight recorder.

items.question: Trong câu "A black box pool (empty, nothing drawn inside) — when you only care about the messages exchanged, not what they do internally.", từ "care about" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A black box pool (empty, nothing drawn inside) — when you only care about the messages exchanged, not what they do internally.", what does "care about" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: care about /ker əˈbaʊt/ (cụm từ): quan tâm tới. Phân biệt: care about (quan tâm) và take care of (chăm sóc).
items.explanationEn: care about /ker əˈbaʊt/ (phrase): to be concerned with. Distinguish care about (be concerned with) from take care of (look after).

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most common and most correct usage for customers, banks, and suppliers.", từ "usage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most common and most correct usage for customers, banks, and suppliers.", what does "usage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: usage /ˈjuː.sɪdʒ/ (danh từ): cách dùng. Còn nghĩa "lượng sử dụng" (data usage); ở đây là cách dùng.
items.explanationEn: usage /ˈjuː.sɪdʒ/ (noun): a way of using. Also means the amount used (data usage); here it is a way of using.

items.question: Trong câu "A full pool — when you genuinely need to describe their internal process.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A full pool — when you genuinely need to describe their internal process.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (trạng từ): thực sự. Tính từ: genuine (thật, chân thật); "genuinely need" = thực sự cần.
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (adverb): truly. Adjective: genuine; "genuinely need" means truly need.

items.question: Trong câu "The greatest value of lanes: they expose the handoffs between roles — the places where business processes most often lose time and information.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The greatest value of lanes: they expose the handoffs between roles — the places where business processes most often lose time and information.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspoʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Expose a problem" = làm lộ vấn đề; trong API "expose an endpoint" = công khai endpoint.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspoʊz/ (verb): to reveal. "Expose a problem" means reveal it; in APIs "expose an endpoint" means make it available.

items.question: Trong câu "The greatest value of lanes: they expose the handoffs between roles — the places where business processes most often lose time and information.", từ "handoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The greatest value of lanes: they expose the handoffs between roles — the places where business processes most often lose time and information.", what does "handoff" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handoff /ˈhænd.ɑːf/ (danh từ): sự chuyển giao. Còn viết handover; mỗi lần chuyển giao là một điểm dễ mất thông tin.
items.explanationEn: handoff /ˈhænd.ɑːf/ (noun): a transfer of work. Also handover; each handoff is a point where information can be lost.

items.question: Trong câu "A subprocess may never cross a pool boundary.", từ "cross" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A subprocess may never cross a pool boundary.", what does "cross" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cross /krɑːs/ (động từ): vượt qua. "Cross a boundary" = vượt ranh giới; "cross out" = gạch bỏ.
items.explanationEn: cross /krɑːs/ (verb): to go across. "Cross a boundary"; "cross out" means strike through.

items.question: Trong câu "It builds shared understanding — often the first time anyone drew the whole end-to-end process.", từ "shared understanding" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It builds shared understanding — often the first time anyone drew the whole end-to-end process.", what does "shared understanding" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: shared understanding /ʃerd ˌʌn.dɚˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (cụm từ): hiểu biết chung. Cụm rất hay dùng trong BA/Agile: "build shared understanding" giữa các bên.
items.explanationEn: shared understanding /ʃerd ˌʌn.dɚˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (phrase): a common grasp. Very common in BA and Agile: "build shared understanding" among stakeholders.

items.question: Trong câu "It builds shared understanding — often the first time anyone drew the whole end-to-end process.", từ "end-to-end" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It builds shared understanding — often the first time anyone drew the whole end-to-end process.", what does "end-to-end" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: end-to-end /ˌend.təˈend/ (tính từ): từ đầu đến cuối. "End-to-end testing" = kiểm thử toàn luồng.
items.explanationEn: end-to-end /ˌend.təˈend/ (adjective): from start to finish. "End-to-end testing" covers the whole flow.

items.question: Trong câu "It exposes waste: repeated steps, waiting, unnecessary handoffs.", từ "waste" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exposes waste: repeated steps, waiting, unnecessary handoffs.", what does "waste" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (danh từ): sự lãng phí. Trong Lean, waste = mọi hoạt động không tạo giá trị; nghĩa khác: rác thải.
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (noun): wasted effort. In Lean, waste is any activity adding no value; it also means rubbish.

items.question: Trong câu "It provides a measurement baseline for proving improvement later.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It provides a measurement baseline for proving improvement later.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): mốc so sánh. "Baseline" = số liệu ban đầu để so sánh sau; trong tennis là vạch cuối sân.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): a reference point. A baseline is the starting data to compare against; in tennis it is the back line.

items.question: Trong câu "It provides a measurement baseline for proving improvement later.", từ "prove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It provides a measurement baseline for proving improvement later.", what does "prove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prove /pruːv/ (động từ): chứng minh. Danh từ: proof (bằng chứng); "prove improvement" = chứng minh có cải thiện.
items.explanationEn: prove /pruːv/ (verb): to show to be true. Noun: proof; "prove improvement" means showing it happened.

items.question: Trong câu "It reveals who actually participates — usually more people than anyone thought.", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reveals who actually participates — usually more people than anyone thought.", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): cho thấy. Trái nghĩa: conceal, hide; danh từ: revelation.
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to show. Opposite: conceal, hide; noun: revelation.

items.question: Trong câu "But do not over-invest in as-is.", từ "over-invest" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But do not over-invest in as-is.", what does "over-invest" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: over-invest /ˌoʊ.vɚ.ɪnˈvest/ (động từ): đầu tư quá mức. Cấu trúc: over-invest in something; tiền tố over- = quá mức.
items.explanationEn: over-invest /ˌoʊ.vɚ.ɪnˈvest/ (verb): to put in too much. Pattern: over-invest in something; prefix over- means too much.

items.question: Trong câu "The risk is real: a team spends three months drawing a perfect, exhaustively detailed model of a process about to be replaced.", từ "exhaustively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The risk is real: a team spends three months drawing a perfect, exhaustively detailed model of a process about to be replaced.", what does "exhaustively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: exhaustively /ɪɡˈzɑː.stɪv.li/ (trạng từ): toàn diện. Tính từ: exhaustive (toàn diện); khác exhausted (kiệt sức).
items.explanationEn: exhaustively /ɪɡˈzɑː.stɪv.li/ (adverb): thoroughly. Adjective: exhaustive; different from exhausted (very tired).

items.question: Trong câu "The risk is real: a team spends three months drawing a perfect, exhaustively detailed model of a process about to be replaced.", từ "about to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The risk is real: a team spends three months drawing a perfect, exhaustively detailed model of a process about to be replaced.", what does "about to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: about to /əˈbaʊt tuː/ (cụm từ): sắp sửa. "Be about to do something" = sắp làm gì.
items.explanationEn: about to /əˈbaʊt tuː/ (phrase): on the point of. "Be about to do something" means it will happen very soon.

items.question: Trong câu "Start from the desired outcome and work backwards.", từ "desired" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start from the desired outcome and work backwards.", what does "desired" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: desired /dɪˈzaɪɚd/ (tính từ): mong muốn. "Desired outcome / state" = kết quả / trạng thái mong muốn.
items.explanationEn: desired /dɪˈzaɪɚd/ (adjective): wanted. "Desired outcome or state" is what you want to reach.

items.question: Trong câu "Start from the desired outcome and work backwards.", từ "work backwards" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start from the desired outcome and work backwards.", what does "work backwards" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: work backwards /wɝːk ˈbæk.wɚdz/ (cụm từ): suy ngược lại. Kỹ thuật lập kế hoạch: bắt đầu từ kết quả rồi suy ngược về các bước.
items.explanationEn: work backwards /wɝːk ˈbæk.wɚdz/ (phrase): to reason from the end. A planning technique: start from the result and reason back to the steps.

items.question: Trong câu "Push decisions to the lowest possible level, escalating only above a threshold.", từ "escalate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Push decisions to the lowest possible level, escalating only above a threshold.", what does "escalate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass up to a manager
items.explanation: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (động từ): chuyển lên cấp trên. Công sở: "escalate an issue" = báo lên cấp cao hơn để xử lý.
items.explanationEn: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (verb): to pass up to a manager. Workplace: "escalate an issue" means pass it to a higher level.

items.question: Trong câu "Parallelise what can be parallel rather than keeping a sequential order.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Parallelise what can be parallel rather than keeping a sequential order.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự. Trái nghĩa: parallel; danh từ: sequence.
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): one after another. Opposite: parallel; noun: sequence.

items.question: Trong câu "Separate the main flow from exception flows — many processes are slow for everyone because they were designed around 5 percent of rare cases.", từ "rare" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate the main flow from exception flows — many processes are slow for everyone because they were designed around 5 percent of rare cases.", what does "rare" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rare /rer/ (tính từ): hiếm gặp. Trạng từ: rarely; "rare case" = trường hợp hiếm; "rare steak" = bít tết tái.
items.explanationEn: rare /rer/ (adjective): uncommon. Adverb: rarely; "rare case"; "rare steak" is lightly cooked.

items.question: Trong câu "does this step exist for a business need, or for a limitation of the old way?", từ "limitation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "does this step exist for a business need, or for a limitation of the old way?", what does "limitation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: limitation /ˌlɪm.əˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): hạn chế. Động từ: limit; "known limitations" = các hạn chế đã biết.
items.explanationEn: limitation /ˌlɪm.əˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a restriction. Verb: limit; "known limitations".

items.question: Trong câu "If the latter, do not automate it — eliminate it.", từ "the latter" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the latter, do not automate it — eliminate it.", what does "the latter" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the latter /ðə ˈlæt̬.ɚ/ (cụm từ): cái sau. Cặp đối: the former (cái trước) và the latter (cái sau).
items.explanationEn: the latter /ðə ˈlæt̬.ɚ/ (phrase): the second of two. Pair: the former (first) and the latter (second).

items.question: Trong câu "If the latter, do not automate it — eliminate it.", từ "automate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the latter, do not automate it — eliminate it.", what does "automate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: automate /ˈɑː.t̬ə.meɪt/ (động từ): tự động hóa. Danh từ: automation; "automate a manual step" = tự động hóa bước thủ công.
items.explanationEn: automate /ˈɑː.t̬ə.meɪt/ (verb): to mechanise. Noun: automation; "automate a manual step".

items.question: Trong câu "If the latter, do not automate it — eliminate it.", từ "eliminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the latter, do not automate it — eliminate it.", what does "eliminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ə.neɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ. Danh từ: elimination; nghĩa khác: bị loại khỏi cuộc thi.
items.explanationEn: eliminate /ɪˈlɪm.ə.neɪt/ (verb): to remove. Noun: elimination; also means knocked out of a competition.

items.question: Trong câu "A model only earns its keep when it produces concrete requirements.", từ "earn its keep" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A model only earns its keep when it produces concrete requirements.", what does "earn its keep" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: earn its keep /ɝːn ɪts kiːp/ (cụm từ): đáng công sức. Thành ngữ: earn its keep = mang lại giá trị xứng với chi phí/công sức.
items.explanationEn: earn its keep /ɝːn ɪts kiːp/ (phrase): to be worth the cost. Idiom: earn its keep means give value worth its cost.

items.question: Trong câu "A model only earns its keep when it produces concrete requirements.", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A model only earns its keep when it produces concrete requirements.", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɑːn.kriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể. Trái nghĩa: abstract; danh từ concrete = bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɑːn.kriːt/ (adjective): specific. Opposite: abstract; as a noun, concrete is the building material.

items.question: Trong câu "What functionality supports this step?", từ "functionality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What functionality supports this step?", what does "functionality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: functionality /ˌfʌŋk.ʃənˈæl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): chức năng. Tính từ: functional; "functional requirement" = yêu cầu chức năng.
items.explanationEn: functionality /ˌfʌŋk.ʃənˈæl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): system features. Adjective: functional; "functional requirement".

items.question: Trong câu "Who is permitted to perform it?", từ "permit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who is permitted to perform it?", what does "permit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: permit /pɚˈmɪt/ (động từ): cho phép. Danh từ permit (/ˈpɝː.mɪt/) = giấy phép; danh từ: permission.
items.explanationEn: permit /pɚˈmɪt/ (verb): to allow. The noun permit is a licence; noun: permission.

items.question: Trong câu "Who is permitted to perform it?", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who is permitted to perform it?", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: perform /pɚˈfɔːrm/ (động từ): thực hiện. Nghĩa khác: biểu diễn; danh từ: performance (hiệu năng, màn trình diễn).
items.explanationEn: perform /pɚˈfɔːrm/ (verb): to carry out. Also means to act on stage; noun: performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Is any branch uncovered?", từ "uncovered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is any branch uncovered?", what does "uncovered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uncovered /ʌnˈkʌv.ɚd/ (tính từ): chưa được xử lý. Động từ uncover = phát hiện; ở đây uncovered = không được bao quát bởi quy tắc nào.
items.explanationEn: uncovered /ʌnˈkʌv.ɚd/ (adjective): not dealt with. The verb uncover means discover; here uncovered means not handled by any rule.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the exact deadline?", từ "deadline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the exact deadline?", what does "deadline" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deadline /ˈded.laɪn/ (danh từ): hạn chót. "Meet a deadline" = kịp hạn; "miss a deadline" = trễ hạn.
items.explanationEn: deadline /ˈded.laɪn/ (noun): a time limit. "Meet a deadline" means finish on time; "miss a deadline".

items.question: Trong câu "Measured from what moment?", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Measured from what moment?", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ɚ/ (động từ): đo, tính. Danh từ measure = biện pháp; "measurement" = phép đo.
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ɚ/ (verb): to quantify. As a noun, measure also means a step or action; "measurement".

items.question: Trong câu "What happens when it expires?", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What happens when it expires?", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪɚ/ (động từ): hết hạn. Danh từ: expiry, expiration; "expiry date" = ngày hết hạn.
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪɚ/ (verb): to run out of time. Nouns: expiry, expiration; "expiry date".

items.question: Trong câu "What happens if the other side does not respond?", từ "respond" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What happens if the other side does not respond?", what does "respond" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respond /rɪˈspɑːnd/ (động từ): phản hồi. Cấu trúc: respond to something; danh từ: response.
items.explanationEn: respond /rɪˈspɑːnd/ (verb): to answer. Pattern: respond to something; noun: response.

items.question: Trong câu "What happens to partial data?", từ "partial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What happens to partial data?", what does "partial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: partial /ˈpɑːr.ʃəl/ (tính từ): dở dang. Nghĩa khác: partial = thiên vị (trái nghĩa impartial); "partial data" = dữ liệu dở dang.
items.explanationEn: partial /ˈpɑːr.ʃəl/ (adjective): incomplete. Another sense is biased (opposite impartial); "partial data" is incomplete data.

items.question: Trong câu "Who belongs to this role?", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who belongs to this role?", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɑːŋ/ (động từ): thuộc về. Cấu trúc: belong to something; danh từ: belongings (đồ đạc cá nhân).
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɑːŋ/ (verb): to be part of. Pattern: belong to something; noun: belongings.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where the model pays its dividend: every symbol you draw generates one or more concrete questions, and every question answered is a requirement that did not get missed.", từ "pay its dividend" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where the model pays its dividend: every symbol you draw generates one or more concrete questions, and every question answered is a requirement that did not get missed.", what does "pay its dividend" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pay its dividend /peɪ ɪts ˈdɪv.ə.dend/ (cụm từ): mang lại lợi ích. Nghĩa bóng từ tài chính: "pay dividends" = đem lại lợi ích về sau.
items.explanationEn: pay its dividend /peɪ ɪts ˈdɪv.ə.dend/ (phrase): to give a benefit. Figurative use from finance: "pay dividends" means bring later benefits.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where the model pays its dividend: every symbol you draw generates one or more concrete questions, and every question answered is a requirement that did not get missed.", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where the model pays its dividend: every symbol you draw generates one or more concrete questions, and every question answered is a requirement that did not get missed.", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra. Danh từ: generation; "generate revenue / ideas" = tạo doanh thu / ý tưởng.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to produce. Noun: generation; "generate revenue or ideas".

items.question: Trong câu "This is where the model pays its dividend: every symbol you draw generates one or more concrete questions, and every question answered is a requirement that did not get missed.", từ "symbol" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where the model pays its dividend: every symbol you draw generates one or more concrete questions, and every question answered is a requirement that did not get missed.", what does "symbol" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: symbol /ˈsɪm.bəl/ (danh từ): ký hiệu. Tính từ: symbolic; đừng nhầm với cymbal (chũm chọe) phát âm giống.
items.explanationEn: symbol /ˈsɪm.bəl/ (noun): a sign or shape. Adjective: symbolic; do not confuse with cymbal, which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN is the international standard addressing flowcharts' weakness: no notation for events, messages, subprocesses, and parallel paths.", từ "address" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN is the international standard addressing flowcharts' weakness: no notation for events, messages, subprocesses, and parallel paths.", what does "address" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to call someone by a title
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (động từ): giải quyết. "Address a problem / concern" = giải quyết vấn đề / mối lo.
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (verb): to deal with. "Address a problem or concern" means deal with it.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN is the international standard addressing flowcharts' weakness: no notation for events, messages, subprocesses, and parallel paths.", từ "weakness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN is the international standard addressing flowcharts' weakness: no notation for events, messages, subprocesses, and parallel paths.", what does "weakness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: weakness /ˈwiːk.nəs/ (danh từ): điểm yếu. "Strengths and weaknesses" = điểm mạnh và điểm yếu; "a weakness for" = thích.
items.explanationEn: weakness /ˈwiːk.nəs/ (noun): a weak point. "Strengths and weaknesses"; "a weakness for something" means a fondness.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose by your audience, and prepare a notation key if the group is unfamiliar.", từ "unfamiliar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose by your audience, and prepare a notation key if the group is unfamiliar.", what does "unfamiliar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unfamiliar /ˌʌn.fəˈmɪl.jɚ/ (tính từ): chưa quen. Cấu trúc: be unfamiliar with something = chưa quen với cái gì.
items.explanationEn: unfamiliar /ˌʌn.fəˈmɪl.jɚ/ (adjective): not used to it. Pattern: be unfamiliar with something.

items.question: Trong câu "Pools mark organizational boundaries and lanes mark internal roles, and the connection rules between them must be respected.", từ "respect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pools mark organizational boundaries and lanes mark internal roles, and the connection rules between them must be respected.", what does "respect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respect /rɪˈspekt/ (động từ): tuân thủ. "Respect a rule / deadline" = tuân thủ quy tắc / hạn; nghĩa khác: kính trọng.
items.explanationEn: respect /rɪˈspekt/ (verb): to follow. "Respect a rule or deadline" means follow it; it also means admire.

items.question: Trong câu "As-is to understand and measure; to-be to design — and do not get stuck in as-is.", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As-is to understand and measure; to-be to design — and do not get stuck in as-is.", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (cụm từ): bị mắc kẹt. "Get stuck in / on something" = sa lầy, không tiến lên được.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (phrase): to stop progressing. "Get stuck in or on something" means be unable to progress.

items.question: Trong câu "A model's ultimate value is that it turns into concrete questions that produce more complete requirements.", từ "ultimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A model's ultimate value is that it turns into concrete questions that produce more complete requirements.", what does "ultimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ultimate /ˈʌl.tə.mət/ (tính từ): rốt cuộc. Trạng từ: ultimately (rốt cuộc); "ultimate goal" = mục tiêu cuối cùng.
items.explanationEn: ultimate /ˈʌl.tə.mət/ (adjective): final. Adverb: ultimately; "ultimate goal".
